tasks.description: Hold an upright Spot posture at the current location.
tasks.criterion_summary: Experimental upright-score, planar-speed, and no-floor-contact checks.

tasks.description: Adjust Spot to the specified body height and hold upright at the current location.
tasks.criterion_summary: Experimental body-height error and upright checks; threshold is not physically calibrated.

tasks.description: Move Spot forward in its initial body-yaw direction for a bounded distance, then stop upright.
tasks.criterion_summary: Experimental forward-displacement, lateral-drift, settle-speed, and contact checks.

tasks.description: Move Spot laterally in its initial body-yaw frame for a bounded distance, then stop upright.
tasks.criterion_summary: Experimental lateral-displacement, forward-drift, settle-speed, and contact checks.

tasks.description: Move Spot's arm to the specified joint posture and hold it.
tasks.criterion_summary: Experimental arm joint-vector error check; target and tolerance are not physically calibrated.
